column1: # Defects of tools/audit_hunts.py that were looked at and left: the owner accepted them or they need a map edit (server/README.md "Hunt audit (O335)").
# tools/audit_hunts.py --check fails on a defect that is not listed here and on a listed one that is gone

column3: reason

Emerald Mage: 58 monsters on 1729 tiles, a full sweep takes 41 s (limit 45). The arrival is a cave under stairs; --suggest finds no larger area of the sign monster in its band. Owner call: more spawns (map edit) or accept.

Scaledrake (level 308): all its spawns on the map are this one group, 30 monsters on 1369 tiles. --suggest finds no larger area of the sign monster. Owner call: more spawns of Scaledrake and Cinderclaw (map edit), another hunt for the slot, or accept.
Same as the sparse flag: 30 monsters, 29 s sweep.
deathrattle (level 289): 22 monsters on 783 tiles, one bonelich in view of the arrival. No larger area of the sign monster. Owner call as Scaledrake.
Same as the sparse flag: 22 monsters, 17 s sweep.
Blackblade (level 275, invisible: the room shows Urzog): 12 monsters on 546 tiles. No larger area of the sign monsters. Owner call as Scaledrake.
Same as the sparse flag: 12 monsters, 12 s sweep.
fangclaw (level 308): 14 monsters on 424 tiles, a 9 s sweep, no larger area of the sign monster in its band. Owner call as Scaledrake.

Plan: 37 spawn points on 1637 walkable tiles (2.3 per 100, limit 3.0), a 35 s sweep. Changing the spawns of a placed plan changes its tiles (the decoration keeps off spawn points), so install_content_areas.py refuses it until the map is restored from its backup. Owner call: give the plan more spawns before launch and restore the map once, or accept the small trial area.
Same plan: 45% of its ground has no monster in view.
Same plan: 35 s sweep (limit 45), 38 monsters.
36% of the ground has no monster in view (limit 35%). Same remedy as hollow_crypt (a plan change needs a map restore); the density is 4.4 per 100, so only the layout is lopsided. Accept.

Tier II plain: 131 spawns on 5547 reachable tiles (2.4 per 100, 42 tiles per monster; the rift limit is 34). The monsters are the base tier files; more spawns lengthen every run. Owner call: balance of the waystone runs.
Tier II cave: 78 spawns, a 35 s sweep. Small by design (a cave map). Accept.

Tier III plain: 262 spawns on 13647 reachable tiles (1.9 per 100, 52 tiles per monster; the rift limit is 34), the map the rift report of 2026-10-29 describes. Owner call: add about 150 spawns of the tier or retire the map (waystone_tiers_config.lua `retired`).
Tier V desert: 487 spawns on 16224 reachable tiles, a 304 s sweep (limit 300). Within 2 percent of the limit. Accept.
Tier VI undead cave: 255 spawns on 8970 tiles (2.8 per 100, 35 tiles per monster). One tile over the rift limit. Accept.

Tier VI forest and desert: 389 spawns on 20896 reachable tiles (1.9 per 100, 54 tiles per monster) and a 392 s sweep. The largest and emptiest map. Owner call: add about 230 spawns of the tier or retire the map.
Same map: 392 s sweep (limit 300).
By design: the late game monsters (level 940) replace weaker spawns in an area of level 344 monsters (tools/late_game.py).
Four floors of stone halls: 146 monsters, a 43 s sweep (limit 45). Owner call: a bigger late game area needs map editing.
By design: late game monsters (level 810) among level 338 ones.

149 monsters on 1454 tiles (10 per 100, limit 6): the base map's own density, left by the late game spawns (README "Not done": 88 areas over 8 per 100). Owner call: thin it with spawn_tuning.json `remove` rows.
Same area: a 25 s sweep.
58 monsters on 1027 tiles, an 18 s sweep. Owner call: a bigger late game area needs map editing.

112 monsters that only the planned hunts spawn are not in bounty_pool.lua, so no bounty contract can name them. Regenerating it (gen_bounty_pool.py on the installed server) adds 109 hunt monsters up to level 1700 and fails tests/descent_test.lua and tests/progression_test.lua (the Descent window and the pool size). Owner call: the bounty and Descent balance. bestiary_spawns.lua is regenerated (O335).
